candidates.name: Lotspeich Co. of Florida, Inc.
candidates.partition_evidence: Building Specialties page lists Bathroom Partitions and shows photos captioned 'Seminole Hard Rock Casino bathroom stalls' and 'bathroom stall door'.
red_flags: Site says 'Serving: Miami & Fort Lauderdale' and lists one Fort Lauderdale office; I found no Riviera Beach office on the site
Large specialty/GC firm (GC License CGC1507337 shown on site); partitions are one of many trades
candidates.reason: Commercial specialty contractor that shows its own bathroom stall installations. Its featured projects include Burns Road Community Center (Palm Beach Gardens) and The Boca Raton, so it works inside the area. Its base is about 40 miles south.
